client.driver: playwright-core 1.60.0 bundled with the official Python package

capabilities.boundary: The host starts obscura serve and supplies its browser WebSocket endpoint
capabilities.acceptance: Connect without patching Playwright and obtain the default BrowserContext

capabilities.boundary: Obscura is not a Chromium executable and is started by the host
capabilities.acceptance: Examples and tests never pass Obscura as executable_path

capabilities.boundary: This method speaks the Playwright protocol rather than CDP
capabilities.acceptance: Examples and tests use connect_over_cdp exclusively

capabilities.boundary: The initial CDP context is created by Obscura
capabilities.acceptance: The connected browser exposes exactly the contexts owned by that connection

capabilities.boundary: Maps to Target.createBrowserContext and disposeBrowserContext
capabilities.acceptance: Create, use, and dispose an isolated context without affecting another context

capabilities.boundary: Each page owns its target, session, document, and realm lifetimes
capabilities.acceptance: Two pages navigate and execute concurrently without cross-page state loss

capabilities.boundary: Navigation requests use the Obscura network stack
capabilities.acceptance: Return the committed document response and preserve CDP event ordering

capabilities.boundary: Evaluation runs in the selected frame and realm
capabilities.acceptance: Values, exceptions, handles, and navigation invalidation match the profile

capabilities.boundary: The unmodified Playwright locator injects its utility script
capabilities.acceptance: Resolve and act on a role locator in the isolated utility world

capabilities.boundary: Accessible-name and label behavior comes through the official locator
capabilities.acceptance: Fill a labelled control without a custom client-side selector fallback

capabilities.boundary: Actionability checks and input commands cross the CDP profile
capabilities.acceptance: Focus, scroll, hit testing, input events, and user activation are observable

capabilities.boundary: Text input is delivered through the shared native input path
capabilities.acceptance: Input and change event ordering matches the fixed Chrome fixture

capabilities.boundary: Selection uses the official locator and page DOM
capabilities.acceptance: Select one and multiple options with matching input and change events

capabilities.boundary: Frame identity and events are owned by the page target
capabilities.acceptance: Enumerate main and child frames with stable parent relationships

capabilities.boundary: Locator utility worlds and object handles are scoped per frame
capabilities.acceptance: Locate and act in a child frame; reject handles from another frame

capabilities.boundary: Observation uses Network domain events from Obscura requests
capabilities.acceptance: Match request, response, body, failure, and redirect events causally

capabilities.boundary: Continue, fulfill, and fail resolve Obscura Fetch interceptions
capabilities.acceptance: Each intercepted request is resolved once and cancellation does not replay it

capabilities.boundary: Playwright performs this fetch outside Obscura and its primp transport
capabilities.acceptance: Do not certify route.fetch for protected site traffic

capabilities.boundary: Playwright performs these requests outside Obscura and its primp transport
capabilities.acceptance: Use page requests or Obscura interception for protected site traffic

capabilities.boundary: Paths are interpreted on the client or server according to the certified connection options
capabilities.acceptance: Define path authorization, size limits, transfer location, cancellation, and cleanup

capabilities.boundary: Download execution and artifact storage location require explicit certification
capabilities.acceptance: Define ownership, path authorization, size limits, cancellation, and cleanup

capabilities.boundary: Pixels are produced by obscura-render and returned through CDP
capabilities.acceptance: Return a nonblank image with fixed viewport, scale, settle, and capture boundary

capabilities.boundary: Trace and HAR behavior is not implied by CDP connection success
capabilities.acceptance: Expose only after artifact ownership and supported events are documented

capabilities.boundary: Closing a target invalidates its sessions, realms, and handles
capabilities.acceptance: No later event is sent to the closed target and sibling pages remain live

capabilities.boundary: Only explicitly created contexts are disposable through CDP
capabilities.acceptance: Dispose owned pages and resources without crossing context boundaries

capabilities.boundary: Disconnect and process ownership are explicit host contracts
capabilities.acceptance: Release connection resources without replaying or duplicating pending input

capabilities.boundary: Client cancellation does not prove the remote action was uncommitted
capabilities.acceptance: Bound waits and report indeterminate writes without automatic replay
